INFJ>INTJ.title: You read people's hearts and build the future with clear logic.
INFJ>INTJ.body: Thinking things through on your own and planning ahead is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both a feel for how people are feeling and a knack for putting things together logically. When you plan, you can ask "Who does this help?" and "Will this really work?" at the same time, so people quietly come to rely on you.
INFJ>INTJ.say: "The logic holds up. …But I'd like to think for a moment about how they'll feel."
INFJ>INTJ.do: The night before a meeting, you fill a notebook with answers to every objection—and kind ways to say them.
INFJ>INTJ.worry: You can see the right answer, but you spend so long on how to say it that you speak up too late. And after you choose the efficient path, you keep thinking about the people you left behind.
INFJ>INTJ.karai: You've planned five years ahead, but you still haven't replied about tomorrow's dinner.

INFJ>INTP.title: Deep kindness and a free, curious mind—you have both.
INFJ>INTP.body: Going deep in your alone time and looking for meaning no one can see is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the warmth to stay close to people's feelings, the curiosity to dig into anything with logic, and both the foresight to plan ahead and the lightness to rethink on the spot. When someone brings you a problem, you take in their feelings—and somehow end up taking the whole problem apart, too.
INFJ>INTP.say: "That sounds really hard. …So, why do you think it happened?"
INFJ>INTP.do: You start looking something up before bed, and three hours later you're reading articles in a totally unrelated field.
INFJ>INTP.worry: You want to help people, but thinking gets so fun that you stop actually doing. Right after making a plan, you think of a better way and want to start over.
INFJ>INTP.karai: You can explain the meaning of life, but your laundry is still sitting in the dryer.

INFJ>ENTJ.title: You turn quiet insight into the power to move people.
INFJ>ENTJ.body: Seeing ahead and turning decisions into results is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the power to think deeply alone and to lead from the front, and the power to sense feelings and to decide with logic. While you pull a team toward a goal, you still notice who's pushing too hard and who's holding back what they want to say.
INFJ>ENTJ.say: "Okay, Friday is the deadline. …Oh, Sam, have you been tired lately?"
INFJ>ENTJ.do: You fit the team's goals onto one sheet—and write in what each member is good at.
INFJ>ENTJ.worry: The more you take on the leader role, the less time you have to think alone. When you need to be firm, their face pops into your head, and later you blame yourself.
INFJ>ENTJ.karai: You make sure everyone else gets their days off, but yours are always "someday."

INFJ>ENTP.title: You feel people's hearts while opening new paths.
INFJ>ENTP.body: Valuing sparks and possibilities is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, your range is wide: quiet thinking and thinking out loud with others, a heart that cares about feelings and a mind that tightens the logic, the power to plan and the lightness to go with the flow. You can get a debate buzzing and still check that no one walked away feeling beaten.
INFJ>ENTP.say: "What if we flip it around? …Oh, sorry if that came out harsh."
INFJ>ENTP.do: You get a new idea from small talk, run with it on the spot, then go home and rework the plan alone.
INFJ>ENTP.worry: Ideas flow when you're with people, but you crash once you get home. Every time, the urge to act on a whim wrestles with the urge to make a solid plan.
INFJ>ENTP.karai: Unbeatable in conversation—then a very long solo review meeting on the way home.

INFJ>INFJ.title: You've grown your gift for sensing the unseen, straight and true.
INFJ>INFJ.body: Your born temperament and the character you grew through experience are the same type. Your power to quietly sense what lies deep in people's hearts and the meaning behind things, and to move step by step toward an ideal, has grown without wavering. Because you know clearly what matters to you, you shine where that is understood—and where it isn't, you tend to wear out without knowing why.
INFJ>INFJ.say: "Don't push yourself. Whenever you feel like talking, I'm here."
INFJ>INFJ.do: You notice a friend is down before they say a word, and quietly hand them their favorite snack.
INFJ>INFJ.worry: You pick up on others' feelings so much that you notice your own tiredness late. Your ideals are high, so the gap with reality can leave you feeling low on your own.
INFJ>INFJ.karai: You can read everyone's mind—except the part where you're running on empty.

INFJ>INFP.title: You grow quiet ideals wherever your heart leads.
INFJ>INFP.body: Recharging alone and valuing intuition and people's feelings is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both the power to plan ahead and move steadily and the flexibility to follow your mood and the moment. You carry a big goal in your heart, yet you also treasure the people and places you find on detours—and they become seeds for your next goal.
INFJ>INFP.say: "I want to do this by next year. …Well, if I change my mind along the way, that's fine too."
INFJ>INFP.do: You buy a beautiful planner and start writing plans; by day three it's a diary and a sketchbook.
INFJ>INFP.worry: When you can't stick to a plan, you feel like a failure. But a packed schedule makes it hard to breathe, so you keep searching for the right balance.
INFJ>INFP.karai: Making the plan is the most fun part of the plan.

INFJ>ENFJ.title: You stay close to people's hearts and lead everyone forward.
INFJ>ENFJ.body: An eye for possibilities, and a way of moving forward with a plan while caring about feelings—your temperament and character share both. Layered on top are the power to think quietly alone and the power to brighten a room full of people. In front of everyone you enjoy bringing the group together, and back home you replay the day's conversations alone, thinking about what to do next time.
INFJ>ENFJ.say: "Thanks so much for coming today, everyone! …Later, I'd love to hear how it was for each of you."
INFJ>ENFJ.do: You plan a group get-together, then send each person a thank-you message afterward.
INFJ>ENFJ.worry: You love helping people, but suddenly you have no time alone at all. It's hard to balance being relied on with wanting to be left alone for a while.
INFJ>ENFJ.karai: You recharge everyone else's heart, but always leave your own charger at home.

INFJ>ENFP.title: Deep care and wide curiosity—you bring people together.
INFJ>ENFP.body: Trusting your intuition and caring about people's feelings is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the power to think deeply in quiet and a bright sparkle in a crowd, plus the foresight to plan and the lightness to follow a sudden idea. You can open up to someone new right away and still catch the feelings behind their words.
INFJ>ENFP.say: "Wait, that's amazing! Let's do it! …Oh, but first, give me a little time to think."
INFJ>ENFP.do: You hit it off with someone on a trip and swap contacts, then soak in the afterglow alone on the train home.
INFJ>ENFP.worry: The more fun the day, the harder the tiredness hits at night. The things you want to do keep piling up; you want to give each one your all, yet they all feel half-done.
INFJ>ENFP.karai: You answer every invite with "I'm in!"—and you're the one hesitating most on the morning of.

INFJ>ISTJ.title: You build deep insight up with solid steps.
INFJ>ISTJ.body: Thinking calmly on your own and moving with a plan is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you can both sense the meaning behind things and check the facts one by one, and you have both a heart that reads feelings and a calm mind that decides with logic. Thoughtful care shows through your precise work, so people often say, "If you're on it, I can relax."
INFJ>ISTJ.say: "The steps are fine as they are. …I'll just add a note here for the new folks."
INFJ>ISTJ.do: You write a precise manual and attach a handwritten note at the end: "Ask me anytime if you get stuck."
INFJ>ISTJ.worry: You often get caught between following the rules and making room for the person in front of you. The future is on your mind, but without solid grounds you can't move, so your thoughts go in circles.
INFJ>ISTJ.karai: You add people's feelings to the checklist, so it gets longer every time.

INFJ>ISFJ.title: You turn deep care into steady, everyday help.
INFJ>ISFJ.body: Recharging alone and moving with a plan while caring about feelings is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the imagination to picture what's ahead and what it means, and the steadiness to rely on past experience and the facts in front of you. You hold big ideals in your heart while never skipping the small daily acts of care—a kindness with both feet on the ground.
INFJ>ISFJ.say: "Things are about to get busy, so I'm getting ready now. …Here, I packed you lunch."
INFJ>ISFJ.do: When a friend moves, you make a schedule for the day—and bring work gloves and drinks for everyone.
INFJ>ISFJ.worry: Picturing the future makes you anxious, so you prepare far more than you need to. With all the planning for others, your own wants tend to get pushed back.
INFJ>ISFJ.karai: You've already perfectly prepared for problems that haven't happened yet.

INFJ>ESTJ.title: You keep things running, with a caring eye.
INFJ>ESTJ.body: Making a plan and seeing your decisions through is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the power to think quietly and to act briskly in front of others, the imagination to picture possibilities and a respect for facts, and a heart that reads feelings alongside a calm mind that decides with logic. While you use rules to keep things in order, you still check that those rules aren't making anyone suffer.
INFJ>ESTJ.say: "I need you to meet the deadline. …But if you're struggling, tell me early, okay?"
INFJ>ESTJ.do: You write a proposal to fix how things run at work, and add its purpose at the end: "So everyone can go home on time."
INFJ>ESTJ.worry: The more you lead the group, the less time you have to sort out your thoughts alone. After giving clear directions, you lie awake wondering if you said too much.
INFJ>ESTJ.karai: Your reason for fixing the system is usually "so nobody ends up in tears."

INFJ>ESFJ.title: You sense people's feelings and make a place for everyone.
INFJ>ESFJ.body: Caring about people's feelings and moving with an eye on what's ahead is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the power to let your imagination roam alone and to jump in and warm up a crowd, and an eye for meaning together with an honest love of everyday life. At gatherings you make sure everyone's having a good time, and you notice even small changes in each person.
INFJ>ESFJ.say: "Tea and snacks are all set! …Hey, you've seemed down for a while—is something up?"
INFJ>ESFJ.do: You plan a birthday party down to the seating, then run through the flow again and again in your head so the guest of honor won't feel awkward.
INFJ>ESFJ.worry: You love seeing people happy, so you do too much, and your battery dies the moment you're alone. Trying to protect the mood, you sometimes miss your chance to say what you think.
INFJ>ESFJ.karai: Fill up on everyone's "thank you," then collapse alone at home—that's your daily routine.

INFJ>ISTP.title: With a kind eye, you fix the problem in front of you fast.
INFJ>ISTP.body: Recharging alone and quietly watching how things are is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the imagination to sense meaning and the hands-on skill to check things yourself, a heart for people and a cool eye for how things work, and the foresight to plan along with the lightness to act on the spot. You may not say much, but when someone's in trouble, your hands get moving and you just fix it.
INFJ>ISTP.say: "Let me see—probably right here. …Fixed. Now you can use it without worrying."
INFJ>ISTP.do: You quietly fix a friend's broken bike and, while you're at it, casually ask, "So how've you been?"
INFJ>ISTP.worry: You show care through actions more than words, so your kindness doesn't always come across. You're torn between thinking long-term and focusing only on what you can do right now.
INFJ>ISTP.karai: First to show up with a toolbox, but "Are you okay?" never quite makes it out.

INFJ>ISFP.title: You pour deep care into the beauty of this moment.
INFJ>ISFP.body: Treasuring quiet time alone and putting people's feelings first is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the power to look at what's ahead and what it means, a feel for the colors and textures right in front of you, and both foresight and a softness that follows your mood. You may be quiet with words, but you can show how you feel through a small gift or gesture.
INFJ>ISFP.say: "These flowers made me think of you. …I just kind of wanted you to feel better."
INFJ>ISFP.do: You choose a seasonal postcard for a friend who's feeling down and send it with a short note.
INFJ>ISFP.worry: You know you should think about the future, but you want to honor how you feel now, so you can't decide. You feel others' pain easily, and one sad news story can weigh on you all day.
INFJ>ISFP.karai: You spend your whole day off picking out a gift to cheer someone else up.

INFJ>ESTP.title: Bold moves and deep care, side by side.
INFJ>ESTP.body: You read the flow of the moment and move fast—you're a person of action. You also have a thoughtful side that quietly senses how people feel and thinks deeply about what things mean. So even when you seem to act on impulse, you're actually watching the people around you closely. You have both lightness and depth.
INFJ>ESTP.say: "Let's just go! …They've seemed down lately, so I want to invite them."
INFJ>ESTP.do: You take a sudden trip on a whim, and on the way back you're the one listening most deeply to your friend's worries.
INFJ>ESTP.worry: Being on the move is fun, but once you're alone, something someone said won't leave your head. People tend to see you as easygoing, and it feels like they don't get how deeply you really think.
INFJ>ESTP.karai: You look like you just go with the vibe, but you've been thinking about the reason for that vibe for three days.

INFJ>ESFP.title: You care about people and enjoy today to the fullest.
INFJ>ESFP.body: Deciding with people's feelings in mind is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the power to think deeply alone and to liven up a crowd, the imagination to see meaning and the ability to savor this moment, and the power to plan along with the lightness to ride the flow. Even at the center of a lively party, you notice who's been left out and invite them in.
INFJ>ESFP.say: "Today is so much fun! …Hey, let's go get the one standing off to the side."
INFJ>ESFP.do: You were the most excited one at the party, but on the way home you wonder alone, "Did she have a good time?"
INFJ>ESFP.worry: After giving your all to a fun time, your heart can't keep up without some time alone. The wish to enjoy now and the wish to prepare for the future take turns showing up.
INFJ>ESFP.karai: The moment you get home, you power off right along with your phone.

INFP>INTJ.title: You turn gentle ideals into reality with careful plans.
INFP>INTJ.body: Going deep in your alone time and picturing possibilities no one sees yet is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both a heart that stays true to what you care about and a mind that decides step by step, and both a softness that enjoys the flow and the power to plan ahead. You don't let the ideal in your heart stay a dream—you break it into steps and make it real.
INFP>INTJ.say: "With this plan, we can get there in three years. …But if it stops being fun, let's rethink it."
INFP>INTJ.do: You turn your favorite story's world into timelines and maps, and your notes end up thicker than the story itself.
INFP>INTJ.worry: The more efficiently you move, the more you stop and ask, "Is my heart actually happy with this?" Even for choices you want to make with feeling, you catch yourself hunting for the "right" reason.
INFP>INTJ.karai: You've made a spreadsheet to score how much things spark joy.

INFP>INTP.title: You deepen a rich imagination with both feeling and logic.
INFP>INTP.body: Loving alone time, valuing sparks of inspiration, and moving freely with your interests is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both a heart that cares about your own and others' feelings and a mind that thinks things through logically. Once you start talking about something you love, you can't stop—and you can explain its charm both the way you felt it and the way it works.
INFP>INTP.say: "This song just makes me cry. …I think it's because the chord changes right here."
INFP>INTP.do: After a movie moves you, you stay up past midnight writing notes on why it moved you.
INFP>INTP.worry: You can't settle until you can explain with logic what you felt. And sometimes you think so hard that you miss the moment to simply enjoy it.
INFP>INTP.karai: While you analyze why you were moved, the feeling quietly leaves the room.

INFP>ENTJ.title: You lead from the front to bring a hidden ideal to life.
INFP>ENTJ.body: Picturing possibilities no one sees yet is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the power to nurture your feelings alone and to lead in front of people, a heart that values feelings and a mind that decides with logic, and the flexibility to adapt along with the drive to plan and finish. While you move a team toward a goal, you can fill that goal with a reason you truly care about.
INFP>ENTJ.say: "We hit the goal by the end of the month. …And honestly, I really love this project."
INFP>ENTJ.do: You lay out the numbers clearly, but the first page of your slides is a passionate "why I want to do this."
INFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you take on the leader role, the less time you get to lose yourself in what you love. After a tough call, you keep wondering whether you went against what you care about.
INFP>ENTJ.karai: Instant decisions in every meeting, thirty minutes to choose dinner.

INFP>ENTP.title: With a gentle touch, you keep new ideas spreading.
INFP>ENTP.body: Trusting your sparks and moving freely with the situation is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the power to let your imagination grow alone and to expand ideas by talking with people, and a heart that cares about feelings alongside a mind that sharpens the logic. You toss out sharp opinions with a joke, and still make sure no one in the room got hurt.
INFP>ENTP.say: "What if we flipped it? …Oh, I don't mean your idea is bad or anything."
INFP>ENTP.do: You come up with a new game while chatting with friends, then go home and secretly build out all the details alone.
INFP>ENTP.worry: When a debate gets fun and you say too much, you stew all night about how they felt. You often feel there isn't enough time for either fun with people or daydreaming alone.
INFP>ENTP.karai: Every sharp comeback comes with a quiet little "just kidding."

INFP>INFJ.title: You grow a gentle imagination with an eye on what's ahead.
INFP>INFJ.body: Settling your heart in alone time and valuing intuition and people's feelings is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both the softness to follow your feelings and the power to see ahead and move steadily. You treasure a sudden idea, keep it warm, and take your time growing it into something that helps people.
INFP>INFJ.say: "I just have a feeling this one's better. …So I'll get it ready by next month."
INFP>INFJ.do: For a hobby you started on a whim, you've somehow filled your planner with a whole year of practice plans.
INFP>INFJ.worry: Caught between wanting freedom and wanting things settled, you make plans and then erase them. Trying to meet others' expectations, you can overpack your plans and leave your own heart behind.
INFP>INFJ.karai: Even your "do whatever I feel like" day is neatly on the schedule.

INFP>INFP.title: You've grown your true colors and gentle imagination, straight and true.
INFP>INFP.body: Your born temperament and the character you grew through experience are the same type. Treasuring what moves your heart, staying close to others' pain, and shaping your thoughts in your own words and ways—this power has grown in you without wavering. Because you know clearly what matters to you, you flourish where it's accepted, and in places that don't fit, you tend to lose energy without knowing why.
INFP>INFP.say: "I think that's really lovely. …I can't quite explain it, but it's just, you know, nice."
INFP>INFP.do: When you find a view you love, you stop, take a photo, and save it with a few words.
INFP>INFP.worry: If you keep doing things that don't fit your heart, you wear down without knowing why. The harder you try to fit in, the easier it is to lose sight of what you loved.
INFP>INFP.karai: The story in your head is past volume ten, but cleaning your room hasn't gotten past page one.

INFP>ENFJ.title: You share gentle ideals and move forward together.
INFP>ENFJ.body: Valuing sparks and deciding with people's feelings in mind is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the power to nurture your feelings alone and to lead within a group, and the softness to follow your heart along with the power to plan ahead. You put what you care about into words, share it with everyone, and make it real together.
INFP>ENFJ.say: "If we do it together, it'll be amazing! …I've already made the schedule."
INFP>ENFJ.do: You gather friends to plan a small event, and between tasks you hide away in a café to write down how you feel.
INFP>ENFJ.worry: While you keep cheering others on, your alone time to settle your feelings disappears. The more you lock in plans to meet everyone's expectations, the less free your heart feels.
INFP>ENFJ.karai: You cheer on everyone's dreams at full volume, but your voice gets tiny when it's your own.

INFP>ENFP.title: You can spread your overflowing imagination, alone or with others.
INFP>ENFP.body: Trusting your sparks, valuing feelings, and going with the flow is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both the power to deepen your imagination alone and the power to get energized by being with people. After making everyone laugh at a lively gathering, you can relive the day like a story on a quiet night.
INFP>ENFP.say: "Let's all go, it'll be so fun! …Oh, but I kind of want to walk home alone after."
INFP>ENFP.do: After a whole day out with friends, you put in your earbuds on the train home and look for a song that fits the day.
INFP>ENFP.worry: You love seeing people, but after too much of it, you suddenly don't want to talk to anyone. You can't predict that wave yourself, and after turning down an invite you feel guilty.
INFP>ENFP.karai: The number of people you've told "Let's hang out soon!" far outnumbers the free days on your calendar.

INFP>ISTJ.title: You give shape to a gentle imagination with solid steps.
INFP>ISTJ.body: Recharging alone and quietly turning things over in your mind is something your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have a sense that pictures what isn't seen yet and the steadiness to stack up facts one by one, a heart that reads feelings and a calm mind that decides with logic, and a free-flowing softness along with the power to finish a plan. People often see you as "the precise one," but kindness and an eye for beauty show up in the small details of your work.
INFP>ISTJ.say: "I'll check and get back to you. …Also, could I change the colors on this document a little?"
INFP>ISTJ.do: You make a flawless how-to guide and put a little drawing on the last page.
INFP>ISTJ.worry: You get everything done properly, yet sometimes feel empty: "Is this what I wanted to do?" Even to start something you love, you find yourself needing a reason and a plan.
INFP>ISTJ.karai: You've put a deadline on your dreams and keep rushing yourself.

INFP>ISFJ.title: You turn a gentle imagination into steady everyday care.
INFP>ISFJ.body: Settling your heart in alone time and deciding with feelings in mind is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are a sense that pictures what isn't seen yet and a steadiness that relies on experience and facts, and the softness to follow your mood along with the power to plan ahead. You remember the tastes and schedules of the people close to you, and add your own little touch.
INFP>ISFJ.say: "Everything's ready for tomorrow. …I also made you this, like a good-luck charm."
INFP>ISFJ.do: You neatly write the family's plans on the calendar and doodle little pictures in the margins.
INFP>ISFJ.worry: In days full of set tasks, the time for things you love keeps shrinking. You're glad to be useful, yet sometimes you wonder, "What did I actually want to do?"
INFP>ISFJ.karai: You never forget anyone's anniversary, but you push back the deadline on your own dream every year.

INFP>ESTJ.title: Firm follow-through and a soft heart, side by side.
INFP>ESTJ.body: You set up the steps and see things through to the end—someone people trust to keep things running. You also have a sensitive side that needs time alone to settle and wants to quietly protect what matters to you. That's why your "let's do it right" isn't coldness; it's sincerity that protects what's important. Your firmness and your kindness come from the same place.
INFP>ESTJ.say: "Let's meet the deadline. …But if anyone's pushing too hard, please tell me."
INFP>ESTJ.do: At work you give crisp directions, and at home you sink alone into the music and books you love.
INFP>ESTJ.worry: The more people rely on you to lead, the more you push your own feelings aside. After saying what's right, you remember the other person's face and feel low.
INFP>ESTJ.karai: A tough-as-nails meeting leader who cries at heartwarming videos on the way home.

INFP>ESFJ.title: With kindness for others, you hold up everyone's days.
INFP>ESFJ.body: Deciding with people's feelings in mind is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the power to let your imagination grow alone and to warm up a group, a sense that values sparks and an honest care for everyday life, and the softness to follow your mood along with a knack for organizing. While you make sure everyone's comfortable, you quietly mix in your own playful touch.
INFP>ESFJ.say: "The seats and food are all set! …And I've got a little surprise planned, too."
INFP>ESFJ.do: You smoothly organize a welcome party at work, and handmake a message card for each new person.
INFP>ESFJ.worry: The more you try to meet everyone's expectations, the less time you have to daydream alone. You care so much about harmony that doing what you love starts to feel "selfish."
INFP>ESFJ.karai: You collect everyone's "That was fun!" and feel satisfied—then push your own fun to next month.

INFP>ISTP.title: You give shape to a gentle sense with skillful hands.
INFP>ISTP.body: Recharging alone and moving freely with the situation is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the imagination to picture what doesn't exist yet and the hands-on skill to check things yourself, and a heart that values feelings alongside a cool eye for how things work. As you quietly make something, you fill it with your own special touches and kindness for whoever will use it.
INFP>ISTP.say: "This just needs one screw. …And while I was at it, I painted it a color you'd like."
INFP>ISTP.do: You repair an old piece of furniture yourself, repaint it in your favorite color, and love it more than before.
INFP>ISTP.worry: Putting feelings into words is hard for you, so your kindness can come off as blunt. Even when you try to be purely logical, your hands stop if your heart isn't on board.
INFP>ISTP.karai: You say "It's nothing," but you remembered their favorite color and finished it in exactly that.

INFP>ISFP.title: You savor both your imagined worlds and the beauty in front of you.
INFP>ISFP.body: Treasuring alone time, putting feelings first, and going with the flow is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have both an imagination that pictures what isn't seen yet and a sense that enjoys the colors, sounds, and textures right in front of you, just as they are. Whatever moves your heart, you can turn into a story in your head or something you make with your hands.
INFP>ISFP.say: "This sunset is beautiful. …It feels like the start of a story."
INFP>ISFP.do: You bring home stones and leaves from a trip, line them up in a little box, and give each one a name from the memory.
INFP>ISFP.worry: You love so many things, but you're not sure how to connect them to your future. You don't like clashing with people, so you quietly swallow what you want to say.
INFP>ISFP.karai: You can't throw out a single keepsake, and your drawer is already a small museum.

INFP>ESTP.title: With a gentle heart, you dive right in.
INFP>ESTP.body: Moving flexibly with the situation is the core your temperament and character share. On top of that, you have the power to grow your imagination alone and to move with energy among people, an inspired sense and a firm grip on the reality in front of you, and a heart that values feelings alongside a cool eye for pros and cons. You give a hesitant friend a push and jump in together, and still check on how they feel afterward.
INFP>ESTP.say: "Don't overthink it, let's just try! …But if you hate it, tell me right away."
INFP>ESTP.do: On a whim you leave on a solo trip that same day, and end up talking late into the night with someone you met there.
INFP>ESTP.worry: After acting on momentum, once you're alone you wonder, "Did that hurt anyone?" Because people see you as up for anything, it's hard to say you want a quiet day.
INFP>ESTP.karai: Bungee jumping? Decided instantly. Flagging down a server? Five minutes.

INFP>ESFP.title: With a gentle sense, you enjoy this moment with everyone.
INFP>ESFP.body: Valuing people's feelings and going with the flow is the core your temperament and character share. Layered on top are the power to sink into your imagined world alone and to brighten a group, and a sense that values sparks along with the ability to savor the fun in front of you. As you go around telling everyone about great food and fun places, you find a story of your own in each one.
INFP>ESFP.say: "I just know you'll all love this place! …Doesn't it feel kind of like a secret hideout?"
INFP>ESFP.do: For a friend's birthday, you start a handmade message album on a whim and finish it just in time.
INFP>ESFP.worry: You pack in so many fun plans that you run short of alone time to settle your heart. Trying so hard to keep the mood bright, you sometimes can't let people see when you're sad.
INFP>ESFP.karai: All smiles in front of everyone, then sad songs and big feelings on the train home.
